messages.message:
Patch Set 6:

(2 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Problematic: the header part is fine, but patch set 6 also carries the whole of https://review.whamcloud.com/57877 (LU-8066 quota: migrate quota out of procfs). PS5 only touched the header and include files. PS6 adds lproc_quota.c, qmt_dev.c, qmt_pool.c, qmt_internal.h, qsd_lib.c, qsd_internal.h, qsd_config.c, lquota_internal.h, lustre_quota.h and the osd-ldiskfs/osd-zfs osd_handler.c, osd_internal.h and osd_lproc.c changes. These hunks match 57877 PS39 line for line, except that the lustre/tests/except/sanity-quota.ex entry is missing. Was this an accidental squash during the rebase? Could the quota/osd hunks be dropped from this change so that they land, or don't land, through 57877's own review? That change still has an open interop problem: older b2_15/b2_16 test suites read /proc/fs/lustre/qmt/*/dt-0x0/glb-usr, and sanity-quota test_48 fails without that file. Without the .ex exclusion, landing it here would bring that failure to master.

commit.subject: LU-18687 build: rework Lustre headers for upstreaming
commit.message:
LU-18687 build: rework Lustre headers for upstreaming

We have many ifdef HAVE_HEADER which makes upstreaming
more difficult. Create compat headers to clean up the
ifdefs. Also include headers we need to build against
the Linux kernel

Test-Parameters: trivial
Signed-off-by: James Simmons <jsimmons@infradead.org>
Change-Id: I2e32960dc2203f03f348821ffa33f5a169add42a
